posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Using $ instead of \$ will cause issue if there is something after the dollar sign.

$HOME

will evaluate to the value of HOME variable instead.
For a literal $ you should escape it. You can find the same mentioned in the question as well.

posts.name: Johnson Philips
posts.cooked: Thanks, but the question was to make the prompt as specified , which is achieved by both options - the ‘if’ there is something after the $ sign is not applicable in this evaluation as there is nothing after it , though I understand the escape sequence…

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: As it is MCQ not MSQ, you’re to select the most correct option
